submitted.rationale: Of the 3 merit measurements, index 74 (Cr0.08 Fe0.62 V0.30) gave the highest photocurrent, 2.76e-6 A. Photocurrent rose as Fe content went up from the FeVO4-like region to the Fe-rich, low-Cr region. That fits Fe-oxide absorption at 2.72 eV.

rejected.reason: Measured 5.3e-7 A, about 5x lower than index 74.
